candidates.change_summary: Replace the assignment in setOwner to set owner to tx.origin instead of the provided _owner parameter.
Replace the assignment in setOwner to set owner to address(0) (zero address) instead of the provided _owner parameter.
Delete the assignment to owner so calling setOwner no longer changes the owner state variable.
Change the onlyOwner guard to require msg.sender != owner (inverse), making calls permitted only to non-owners.
Insert a check that prevents assignment when _owner is address(0); if zero, do not change owner.
Change function to set owner but return false instead of true.
Set owner then return the zero address (as a bool via comparison) — return true only if new owner is zero address, changing returned value for non-zero args.

Modify onlyOwner to invert the require so that it reverts for the original owner and allows others; this changes whether setOwner completes and its return value can differ when call completes — but here we ensure it still compiles and can allow different callers to reach setOwner returning different values.
Replace assignment to owner with assignment to tx.origin so setOwner can change owner to transaction origin instead of supplied _owner.
Replace assignment to owner with assignment to msg.sender so setOwner sets owner to the immediate caller rather than the provided _owner.
Delete the assignment to owner so calling setOwner no longer changes the owner value.
Insert assignment setting owner to address(0) so setOwner will zero out the owner instead of using _owner.
Replace assignment to owner with assignment to _owner transferred through payable conversion to ensure type usage differs.
Change onlyOwner require to compare against tx.origin instead of owner, altering who can call setOwner and thus affecting final owner.
Change onlyOwner require to compare against address(0) so the modifier always reverts unless owner is zero, preventing setOwner from succeeding normally.
Invert the require condition so only non-owners can call functions using onlyOwner, changing who can set owner.
Remove the require from onlyOwner so the modifier no longer restricts access and setOwner becomes callable by anyone, changing resulting owner based on caller-provided _owner.
